text.text: Four steps: research the phrase, write the page, share it, then watch the rank. Everything below is linked, so rank and results sit next to the content.
Open any post to find a page brief (keyword, intent, outline, links, call to action) already inside it.
When a post is published, post it once on each channel and send it to the email list.
Opportunity score rewards phrases people search often that are not too hard to win. Start with the highest scores that have no post yet.
Collect phrases customers use, from support questions and search suggestions.
Choose the intent: a page can answer only one well.
Target the phrases with the best searches against difficulty first.
The priority score is searches divided by one hundred for any phrase under forty difficulty. Higher is better.
Update current rank on each tracked phrase
Note rank changes of five or more
Retire phrases we no longer want
